no_id_check_policy.rule: CRITICAL: Do NOT display any ID check, KYC, or documentation requirement flags/badges on any country or number prior to checkout. All 17 countries are presented clean. Documentation request is presented post-payment in user dashboard.

checkout_flow.onboarding_rule: First-time users pay via Crypto on initial registration onboarding.
checkout_flow.auto_renew: Auto-renew toggle is ENABLED (checked) by default on checkout.
checkout_flow.post_payment: Instant number activation, redirect to dashboard line management

auth_and_session.logoff_behaviour: When user logs out, clear auth state and redirect directly to landing page (/)
auth_and_session.google_one_tap: Keep existing Google One-Tap auth support styled cleanly.

image_urls.description: High-tech telecom cable network and server rack representing cloud IVR global infrastructure
Modern data center server rack glowing with connectivity status lights
Fiber optic connections highlighting low latency SIP trunking

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Maintain strict Telnyx high-contrast aesthetic: pure dark (#0A0D0E) alternating with cream (#FEFDF5).
Use uppercase condensed headings (Barlow Condensed / Syne) paired with ultra-clean body text (Inter / DM Sans).
Never display ID verification badges or document warning badges before payment confirmation.
Auto-renew toggles MUST be checked (true) by default in checkout and billing settings.
Logoff action MUST navigate the user back to the public landing page (/)
Every key interactive component MUST include the corresponding data-testid attribute for automated testing.
